elaine (AE): FYI team — final pen test report + evidentiary artifacts (vuln scan, network captures) are ready to hand to ACME for their vendor review. I uploaded the bundle to our secure share.

mike (Security Eng): Thanks. Did we redact customer-specific PII and samples before upload? ACME asked for redacted artifacts only. :eyes:

elaine (AE): Yes — mike confirmed redaction. Also attached a short remediation timeline and assigned owners.

sec-bot: Upload complete — file id: rbw-sec-2026-03-acme-pt-1764506789.tar.gz, access: limited, expires: 2026-04-05.

raj (Ops): Link (presigned) -> https://storage.redwood.example/rbw-sec-2026-03-acme-pt-1764506789.tar.gz?sig=xxxxxxxx (expires 2026-04-05). Use this to download artifacts for the customer package.

julia (ACME Sec): Got it, downloading now. Quick Q: does the report include PoC for CVE-2025-1234? They flagged that one specifically.

mike (Security Eng): Yes — PoC and exploit trace is in evidence/pocs/CVE-2025-1234.txt and an attached pcap in evidence/pcaps/cve-2025-1234.pcap. We left the PoC in plaintext but redacted any customer creds.

elaine (AE): Remediation owners + ETA (high-level):
- CVE-2025-1234 (priv escalation) — owner: mike (Security Eng) — target fix & patch validation: 2026-03-28
- SCA dependency vuln (medium) — owner: raj (Ops) — dependency update + rollout: 2026-04-02
- Config hardening (low) — owner: platform-sre (team) — policy enforcement + infra-as-code changes: 2026-04-10

raj (Ops): I'll attach the exact rollout windows after I sync with infra on change freeze.

mike (Security Eng): Quick notes for ACME: we confirmed no lateral movement in the scope, KMS keys unaffected, and audit logs for the window are in evidence/logs/2026-03-12-audit.log. We recommend verifying token rotation post-patch.

julia (ACME Sec): Thanks — can you include a short “how to validate” checklist for each fix? Our vendor team prefers step-by-step validation they can run.

elaine (AE): Will do. I'll add validation checklist to the bundle and re-upload. Expected by EOD today.

sec-bot: New upload: rbw-sec-2026-03-acme-pt-1764506789-v2.zip (includes validation checklists).

mike (Security Eng): For ACME validators — sample validation commands:
```
# check patch applied on app nodes
ssh node-01 "rpm -q redwood-app | grep 3.2.1-rcv"
# run quick scan
nmap -sV --script vuln -p 22,80,443 acme.example.com
# validate dependency versions
python3 -c "import pkg_resources; print(pkg_resources.get_distribution('requests').version)"
```

julia (ACME Sec): Perfect. Two last asks: (1) can you provide an attest file signed by your compliance team that confirms artifact integrity? (2) export of findings in CSV for our GRC import.

elaine (AE): Yes to both. I asked compliance and they said they can sign the attest by EOD tomorrow. CSV export will be attached in the v3 bundle.

raj (Ops): One operational note — rolling patch will require a short maintenance window (5–10 min/node). I'll mark that in the remediation calendar and share a change ticket link.

mike (Security Eng): We're marking the CVE severity as Critical -> Public exploit available; mitigation: patch + config. Full remediation plan in report section 4.

julia (ACME Sec): Acknowledged. We'll share the internal review results after validation. Thanks for the fast turnaround. :thumbsup:

elaine (AE): Thanks everyone. I'll update the thread with v3 link and compliance attest once available.

sec-bot: Note: access logs show julia downloaded rbw-sec-2026-03-acme-pt-1764506789-v2.zip at 1764509123.
